verdict.rationale: Mollie documents a Balances API for real-time and historical balance data, aimed at bookkeeping integration. Its Settlement Report breaks down each payout into all transactions, fees and deductions to support reconciliation. The hosted MCP server exposes both the Balances and Settlements APIs, so an agent can pull this data directly. Missing for 10: no explicit evidence that the Settlements API (rather than the report) returns per-payment line items for each settlement; no named balance-transactions endpoint or field-level detail; no independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent completing a reconciliation.
